source: hanamizuki (note 88 ; ouvertures notées 4-5 : mer à l'heure bleue, shoji), willowcamp (linge plié, table de pique-nique, saules la nuit, toutes régénérées et validées), talon-libre (linge de lit, serviettes, table au bougeoir), artic (hospitalité de luxe), ateliersources.
style: Contemporary editorial hospitality photography, quiet and slow, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, medium-format look, subtle 35mm film grain, generous negative space, realistic, high detail.
interdits: No guests, no staff, no bed with someone in it, no famous landmark, no postcard cliché, no room presented as the real establishment, no signage.
evite: Évite de faire passer une chambre inventée pour la vraie : Grok fournit les matières, le linge, la lumière et le paysage, les chambres restent les vraies photos.

404.consigne: A neatly made bed in an empty room with a single room key left on the folded blanket, {lumiere}, calm, a gentle touch of humour, nobody.

ouverture.consigne: Wide calm view of {sujet} at blue hour seen from a low angle, gentle mist, a single warm glow in the distance, minimal composition with a large empty sky.

section-fond.consigne: Soft morning light glowing evenly through closed translucent curtains or paper screens, thin wooden frame, empty and minimal, no furniture, no shadows of people.
section-fond.evite: Les ombres de personnes derrière le voilage.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up still life of {sujet} on a light oak bench, neatly folded thick white linen and a soft wool blanket beside it, calm and immaculate, nobody in the frame.
scene-metier.source: talon-libre (linge plié, coin de lit), willowcamp linge-plie-lumiere
scene-metier.evite: La femme de chambre, le lit défait.

lieu.consigne: Landscape around the stay at first light: {sujet}, gentle mist, no buildings, no roads, no vehicles, an atmospheric mood image, not a portrait of the real establishment.
lieu.evite: Le monument ou le cliché régional (chalets de carte postale exclus par talon-libre et artic).

texture.consigne: Close-up of soft natural linen draped in gentle folds on {matieres}, morning light crossing it with delicate leaf shadows, lots of calm negative space.
texture.source: tonchemindevie (lin et ombres de feuilles), willowcamp texture papier

portrait-generique.consigne: Seen from behind, a guest wrapped in a soft blanket sitting by a large window with a cup of tea, only a shoulder and softly blurred hair visible, face not visible at all, quiet and safe atmosphere.
portrait-generique.source: tonchemindevie (personne de dos dans un plaid), talon-libre
